result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there is one clear content bug (a '−0%' discount badge that conveys no discount) plus a couple of minor styling inconsistencies in the restaurant cards (favorite icon treatment and image background styles). Carousel edge clipping and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' displays a discount badge reading '−0%'. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and looks like a broken/unformatted promo value, which undermines trust in the offers shown.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the computed discount is 0 (or null), and only render it for valid positive discounts. Verify the data source/formatting logic that produced '−0%' (likely a rounding or sign-formatting bug).

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button is styled inconsistently between cards: on the ramen card it sits directly on the dark image with no backing shape, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular scrim. On lighter imagery the un-backed white heart would have poor contrast.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent semi-transparent circular background (scrim) behind the heart icon on all restaurant cards to guarantee contrast and visual consistency.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the first card uses a light gray image background while the neighboring cards use dark blurred backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card image treatment (consistent background/blur or a uniform fallback placeholder) so all thumbnails in a row share the same visual style.
